pendaftaran.title: Visit registration
pendaftaran.keywords: register registration visit counter appointment schedule queue number
pendaftaran.answer: Open Registration > Visit Registration. Search the patient by MRN, ID number, or name, choose an available doctor schedule, then save. The system issues the Registration No. and clinic queue number automatically.

pasien.title: New patient data
pasien.keywords: new patient medical record mrn id identity edit data
pasien.answer: Open Master Data > Patient, click Add, then fill in the ID number, name, date of birth, and gender. The MRN is issued automatically by the server. Patient data can also be searched and edited on the same page.

antrean.title: Clinic queue
antrean.keywords: queue call status waiting examined cancel clinic
antrean.answer: Open Registration > Clinic Queue. Filter by clinic, date, or status, then move the queue status from waiting to examined, done, or cancelled. Every status change is logged.

displayAntrean.title: Queue display screen
displayAntrean.keywords: display screen tv waiting room monitor public call
displayAntrean.answer: The queue display screen is at /display-antrean and opens without login, suitable for a waiting room TV. Data refreshes automatically and can be filtered per clinic.

pemeriksaan.title: Doctor examination
pemeriksaan.keywords: examination examine doctor worklist anamnesis diagnosis icd soap procedure
pemeriksaan.answer: Doctors open Examination to see today's patient worklist. Pick a patient, fill in anamnesis and examination, then add ICD-10 diagnoses, procedures, prescriptions, and lab orders from the same page.

riwayatMedis.title: Patient medical history
riwayatMedis.keywords: medical history record previous visits past diagnosis
riwayatMedis.answer: Open Medical History, search the patient by MRN or name, then review examinations, diagnoses, and procedures from previous visits.

farmasi.title: Pharmacy and prescriptions
farmasi.keywords: pharmacy prescription medicine drug dispense process stock
farmasi.answer: Doctors write prescriptions from the examination page. Pharmacy staff open Pharmacy to see the prescription queue, process it, and hand over the medicine. Drug stock decreases automatically when a prescription is dispensed.

laboratorium.title: Laboratory
laboratorium.keywords: lab laboratory order result test sample reference range
laboratorium.answer: Doctors create lab orders from the examination page. Lab staff open Laboratory to see the order worklist and enter results per test. Results outside the reference range are flagged.

billing.title: Billing and payment
billing.keywords: billing bill invoice pay payment cashier paid print receipt
billing.answer: Open Billing. Create an invoice from an unbilled visit, then process cash, transfer, QRIS, or EDC payment. Partial payments are allowed; invoices and receipts can be printed.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and reports
dashboard.keywords: dashboard report chart statistics revenue visits export excel pdf
dashboard.answer: Dashboard & Reports appears on the home page and the Dashboard menu. It summarizes visits per clinic, top procedures, revenue, drug usage, and payments, with a period filter and PDF/Excel export.

jadwal.title: Doctor schedule
jadwal.keywords: doctor schedule practice day hour quota
jadwal.answer: Open Master Data > Doctor Schedule to set practice days, hours, and quota per doctor and clinic. These schedules are used during visit registration.

obat.title: Drug master and stock
obat.keywords: drug medicine stock price mutation adjustment adjust
obat.answer: Open Master Data > Drug to add drugs and prices. Use the stock actions to adjust stock and view the mutation history.

masterData.title: Other master data
masterData.keywords: master doctor clinic procedure tariff icd10 lab test
masterData.answer: The Master Data module contains Doctor, Clinic, Procedure, Lab Test, ICD-10, Drug, Doctor Schedule, and Patient. Each menu offers add, edit, delete, and search according to role permissions.

userRole.title: Users, roles, and access rights
userRole.keywords: user role access right permission menu module password
userRole.answer: The System module contains User, Role, Module, Menu, and Role Access. Set read, create, update, and delete permissions per menu on the Role Access page. Sidebar menus follow the user role permissions.

pengaturan.title: Language, theme, and menu search
pengaturan.keywords: language english indonesian theme dark mode search menu ctrl
pengaturan.answer: The ID/EN button in the header switches language, the theme button toggles light/dark mode, and Ctrl+K opens menu search.
